# Simplified supply

Used in [Abstract logistics and air](/rules/95-abstract-logistics-and-air), [Air Game — abstract logistics with the Air Game](/rules/air/90-abstract-logistics).

## Axis

- **Letters:** A, B, C, D, E, F, G
- **Arrive turns later:** 2

## Notes

- Abstract Logistics (SPI 32.4x, rules/95-abstract-logistics-and-air.md): each turn the Axis player rolls one die under the tonnage availability letter of the month he plans in and gets that many supply units two turns later; the Commonwealth player rolls under the supply period of the arrival turn and gets them four turns later
- The two tables sit on the player chart sets: Axis (32.46) on jp2 176, Commonwealth (32.47) on jp2 141. Transcribed from the archive.org scan and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scans (scan:discord:Axis Charts.pdf:p34 and scan:discord:Commonwealth Charts.pdf:p31): 0 of 42 Axis cells and 0 of 18 Commonwealth cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no charts
